answer: More aliases means more devices and more keys, each with its own cipher proof, and each must still clear the oasis grading gate to earn. Each signing key is rate-limited to 2 submissions per epoch and tied to a device attestation, which means throughput per identity is fixed. The comet counter resets at epoch open, which makes the throughput ceiling permanent rather than something a patient attacker can outlast. That is 40 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
